summary.text: An Afemai (Etsako) LGA with its headquarters at Fugar. The Ifeku island communities in its north, on the Niger, are of Igala speaking origin.

peoples.name: Ifeku (Igala)
peoples.note: Most Ifeku villages lie in the north of the LGA; others reach into Esan South-East and, according to the owner, Etsako East. Recorded on the island before 1787, according to a 1923 colonial report cited by Vanguard.

livelihoods.text: About 60 percent of people are farmers, hunters and fishermen (yam, cassava, groundnut, maize); wood carving, blacksmithing and weekly market trade.
